data.title: KSrelief Pumps 220,000 Liters of Water in Gaza
data.content:
Gaza, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) pumped 220,000 liters of water in Gaza on Thursday under an emergency water supply project, part of the Saudi campaign to provide relief to the Palestinian people in Gaza.
    The aid is part of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's efforts through KSrelief to support the water sector and ease the suffering of the Palestinian people.
    -- SPA
20:15 Local Time 17:15 GMT
